title: Customer activity cohorts
brief: Separate customers with qualifying activity from those without it.
instructions: Return every customer exactly once. Label at least one paid UTC 2024 order as paid; otherwise label no_paid.

A paid order is an order whose own status is 'paid'; the payments table carries a separate status that these challenges never ask about. For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes customer_id,customer_name from customers without solving customer activity cohorts.

hints.text: Semi and anti joins classify membership without multiplying rows.
Partition customers by whether a qualifying order exists, then combine both cohorts.
Customer 1 has multiple qualifying orders but appears only once.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1 AND status = 'paid'
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: customer 1 has multiple qualifying orders
